card.name: Single-dose and one-time wording
card.fires_on: Words that mark a single or one-off item, such as 'one' in 'even one dose', 'doses' after 'Single oral', and 'ose' in 'single- and repeat-dose'. Also weaker on some non-drug phrases like 'solo' flight or 'Year of Science'.

modes.label: Single dose phrasing
modes.description: Word for a single dose or occurrence just before the dose noun or in 'single' dose phrases.
modes.example: Accidental ingestion of even<< one>> dose of tapentadol hydrochloride

modes.label: Toxicity studies of single doses
modes.description: The word 'doses' or 'dose' after 'Single' in overdose or animal study text.
modes.example: Single oral<< doses>> of amlodipine maleate

modes.label: Non-drug one-off or named period
modes.description: Words in general text about a one-time event or a named year.
modes.example: In the aftermath of his 1927<< solo>> transatlantic flight

card.writes: It suppresses recurring-time words like yearly, annually and each time, so it favors one-time over repeating wording.
card.plain: It notices wording about a single, one-time dose or event rather than something that repeats.
